title: Parachute/Settings, after the app record
description: What stays in the settings note: what belongs to the person, not to one app. The bar, start and services move into an app record; they are still allowed here while old and new devices overlap.

app.description: The app a new device opens: an app record's id. A device's own choice wins.

bar.description: Before app records, and for one release after: kept in step with the app named in `app`, so a device not yet updated keeps its bar. Then gone.
